paite: Huan Mosi leh Israel upate'n Huniadania ka hon piak thupiak tengteng zui un.
heading: Suangte Tung A Kigelh Pathian Dante
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak a lut dia Jordan na kan ni chiang un hichi ahi ding a, suang liantakte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

paite: Na galkah khit chiang un atung uah hiai dan thu tengteng na gelh ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon na chiamsa bang in nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam ah na pai thei ding uhi.
english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

paite: Jordan lui na galkah khit chiang un hichi ahi ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak bang in Ebal tang ah suangte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in maitam, suang maitam na bawl ding uh ahi. Vanzat ding in sik na zang ding uh ahi kei,
english: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam suang sek louh in na bawl ding uh ahi. Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in halmang thillatte na lan ding uhi.
english: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.

paite: Kilepna thillatte in na kithoih ding ua, huai ah na ne ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.
english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.

paite: Suangte ah hiai dan thu tengteng teltak in na gelh ding uh ahi," chi in.
english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Levite'n Israel mi tengteng ahoupih ua, Israel mite aw, hoihtak in ngaikhia un. Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh mite na hong hita uhi.
english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih ding uh ahi. Tuni a ka hon thupiakte leh adante na zuih ding uh ahi, achi uhi.
english: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

paite: Huai ni mah in Mosi in mipite thu apia a,
heading: Thuman Louh Ziak A Hamsiatnate
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

paite: "Jordan lui gal na kah khit chiang un mipite vualzawl ding in Gerizim tang a hiaite adin ding uh ahi: Simeon nam, Levi nam, Judah nam, Issakar nam, Joseph nam leh Benjamin nam.
english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

paite: Hamsiat ding in hiaite Ebal tang a adin ding uh ahi: Reuben nam, Gad nam, Asher nam, Zebulun nam, Dan nam leh Naphtali nam," achi hi.
english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

paite: Levite'n ahon gen pan ua, Israel mi tengteng kiang ah aw ngaihtak in,
english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

paite: "Khutsiamte khutsuak TOUPA a dia kihhuai milim tunkhiak tawm hiam, gukkep peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen,” chi in ana dawng ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Anu hiam, apa hiam zahtak lou peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "A-invengte gamgi suanmi hamsethuak in om hen,” achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Lampi a pan mittaw lampi lou a paisakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Gamdangmi, pa nei lou leh meithai vai dikloutak a hawmsakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Apa zi kithuahpihmi ham-sethuak in om hen," apa nik lem ahih ziak in, achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Bang gan peuhpeuh kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam, kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Asungnu kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "A-invengte gukthahmi ham-sethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Poi khoih lou thahna ding a golhna lami hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

paite: "Hiai dan thute zui ding a pomkip lou mi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” achi ding uhi.
english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”
